command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='promql/sort_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
marker='''\t\t{"typed before untyped", "1", "foo", -1},
\t}'''
addition='''\t\t{"typed before untyped", "1", "foo", -1},
\t\t{"bare exponent vs valid exponent", "1e", "1e1", 1},
\t\t{"nan natural order", "NaN", "nan", -1},
\t\t{"numeric equal scientific tie-break", "1e3", "1000", -1},
\t\t{"duration equal tie-break", "1.5e2m", "150m", -1},
\t\t{"bytes equal tie-break", "1KiB", "1024B", -1},
\t\t{"ipv4 mapped vs ipv6", "::ffff:192.168.1.1", "::ffff:192.168.1.2", -1},
\t\t{"cidr ipv6 smaller prefix first", "2001:db8::/32", "2001:db8::/64", -1},
\t\t{"timestamp equal instant tie-break", "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z", 1},
\t\t{"tab leading whitespace", "\\t1", "0", -1},
\t}'''
assert marker in s
s=s.replace(marker, addition)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w promql/sort_test.go && timeout 120 go test ./promql/ -run 'TestCompareLabelValues' -count=1 2>&1 | tail -30
